name: avoid-ai-writing-tropes
description: Find canned phrasing, vague claims, and repetitive patterns, then revise only what weakens the prose.

interface.shortDescription: Find and fix canned, generic prose
interface.longDescription: Review or revise prose for canned openings, vague claims, forced transitions, repetitive patterns, and generic conclusions. Keep the writer's facts, voice, and genre intact. Never guess authorship from style.
defaultPrompt: Cut the canned setup and vague claims from this draft. Keep my facts and voice.
Show me where this prose sounds generic, but don't rewrite it yet.
Rewrite this in plain, specific language without flattening my style.
